subject: Tranche PO issuance discrepancy + itemization questions
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@aardvark.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tranche PO issuance discrepancy + itemization questions

Hi Priyo / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. We pulled the PO summary from your portal and spotted two issues we need help resolving before our first invoice:

1) Two provisional PO numbers were issued (PO-2026-778 and PO-2026-779) against the same onboarding request. The total spend cap on PO-778 is $45,000; PO-779 shows $10,000. Together they sum to the expected $55,000, but our accounting team needs a single canonical PO for the tranche.

2) Several line items were combined under a generic SKU (RDW-SVC-GEN) in the export — specifically the "embedding storage" and "inference-hours" lines. We need them split into distinct SKUs for chargeback: EMB-STORE and INF-HOURS.

Attached: onboarding_form.pdf (completed), po_summary.csv (export from portal).

Can you advise the process to: a) collapse the provisional POs into a single issued PO (with a single spend cap) or tell us the recommended way to treat dual provisional POs, and b) correct the itemization so our AP can code invoices properly?

We need this resolved by next Tuesday for month-end processing. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Lowe
Head of Procurement
Aardvark Analytics
attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), po_summary.csv (CSV)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@aardvark.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tranche PO issuance discrepancy + itemization questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments.

Quick answers up front:
- We can reissue a single canonical PO and retire the provisional duplicate; procurement will generate a consolidated PO number and map the spend cap to that single record.
- We can also split the combined SKU into EMB-STORE and INF-HOURS on the PO line items. That requires a brief workback to update the onboard mapping and regenerate the PO export.

Action plan I propose (short timeline):
1) I created PROC ticket #4321 and assigned to Ben for PO reissuance + spendcap consolidation. (Jira link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROC-4321)
2) Ben to confirm which of the two provisional POs should be treated as the source of truth or if we should create a fresh PO (expected ETA: next business day).
3) Laura to coordinate SKU remapping in the onboarding form and push line-item changes to the ledger. (We will share an interim CSV for your AP to validate before finalization.)
4) We will supply a final PO export and a reconciliation memo for your AP.

Could you confirm which of these options you prefer: A) consolidate under PO-2026-778 (move remaining $10k into it) or B) create a new single PO retaining your original reference (we can put a mapping note to both provisional numbers)? Option A is faster; option B is cleaner for you if you want a new single PO reference.

Given your month-end timeline, if we don't hear back by EOD today we'll start with Option A and keep you looped in.

Thanks,
Priyo Das
Vendor Ops (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
attachments: procurement_ticket_4321.txt (ticket stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@aardvark.io>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tranche PO issuance discrepancy + itemization questions

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 11:03 AM priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
> I created PROC ticket #4321 and assigned to Ben for PO reissuance + spendcap consolidation.

Thanks Priyo — I've reviewed the ticket and the PO export. Recommendation: create a new consolidated PO (PO-2026-790) and map 778 & 779 as legacy references. Reasoning: avoids ledger surprises if either provisional PO has been partially billed. I'll do the reissue and set the canonical spend cap to $55,000.

For the SKU split: Laura, can you confirm the line-level quantities for EMB-STORE vs INF-HOURS? Sarah, if you can confirm the AP GL codes for those two SKUs (or tell us the exact descriptions you want), we'll push the remap and regenerate the export.

Planned schedule:
- Today: I will create PO-2026-790 and set spend cap to $55,000; retire 778/779 as provisional.
- Today afternoon: update ledger and push a draft PO export to Sarah for validation.
- Monday: finalize SKU split and publish final PO to portal.

Attaching reissue_plan.xlsx with proposed line-item split and mapping notes.

Ben Carter
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: reissue_plan.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@aardvark.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tranche PO issuance discrepancy + itemization questions

Thanks Ben / Priyo — that plan works for us.

We prefer the new canonical PO (Option B) so our invoices reference PO-2026-790. Our AP GL codes: EMB-STORE -> 5201; INF-HOURS -> 4302.

One small ask: while you reissue, can you confirm whether interim invoices billed to PO-778/779 will be credited to PO-790 or if we should hold invoices until the new PO is live? We have one vendor bill pending this week.

If you can push the draft export today as planned, I'll get AP to validate the GL mapping quickly. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Procurement
Aardvark Analytics
